purpose: Clinova Phase 4, Epic 4.3 Bucket B: structural, deterministic fixtures (no live API calls) exercising canonical_resolver.py code paths v1/v2 don't cover -- the title_author_year fallback, the title_only_partial/QUARANTINED path, and a real title-collision risk. Declared as v1's successor format (v1's MANIFEST.json is immutable=true, so new structural cases cannot be added there per 07-evaluation-architecture.md Section 2's immutability rule) -- same fixture style (structural, deterministic, pytest-runnable), a superset schema v1's 4 cases can eventually migrate into (deferred, optional follow-up).
note: Cases 1-3 are pure canonical_resolver.py fixtures (no PDF/LLM dependency), built from real bibliographic records already present in evals/benchmarks/v1's fixtures (not invented). Cases 4-5 reprocess the real PDFs already in Data-17072026/ via a live seed script (evals/benchmarks/v3/seed_from_real_corpus.py) -- see each case file's own 'source' field for exact provenance. Methodology correction (2026-08-24): the top-level 'purpose' field's '(no live API calls)' parenthetical describes cases 1-3 only, not this benchmark version as a whole -- case-missing-abstract.json's build_case_missing_abstract() genuinely calls pipeline.wiki_compiler.build_wiki() twice against the real NVIDIA API (once per ablation variant), so re-running seed_from_real_corpus.py costs real live LLM calls. case-parser-failure.json's build_case_parser_failure() makes no API calls at all -- it only exercises pipeline.pdf_parser.parse_pdf() and pipeline.docling_parser.extract_with_docling() against a deterministically truncated local file.
